description: This file defines an unimplemented network interface iterator class and a template class for unimplemented network info, serving as placeholders or default implementations within the WPEFramework's process container module.

classes.name: UnimplementedNetworkInterfaceIterator
classes.description: A placeholder implementation of INetworkInterfaceIterator that returns default or empty values.

classes.name: NetworkInfoUnimplemented
classes.description: A template class providing a default implementation for network information, returning an unimplemented network interface iterator.

methods.name: NetworkInterfaces
methods.description: Returns a new instance of UnimplementedNetworkInterfaceIterator, representing an unimplemented network interface list.
